todos: [P2] OLLAMA-THINKING-GPTOSS-LIVE-01: when a GPT-OSS model is available locally, verify its actual Ollama family/capabilities and behavior in the app, confirm Settings shows only the level-only compatibility note (no false off switch), and confirm the runtime remains usable with the documented think:false default. Unit coverage is complete; this live model-specific check was not possible on 2026-09-22 because GPT-OSS was not installed.

[P1] AUDIT-IPC-VALIDATION-01: complete channel-specific runtime schemas for every IPC handler with input (the new secureIpcMain wrapper currently validates only high-risk channels explicitly and uses a generic JSON shape for remaining channels); remove any from touched Preload contracts and add a static guard against direct ipcMain registration outside the wrapper.

[P1] AUDIT-SIDECAR-OWNERSHIP-01: verify the Sidecar ownership marker and unknown-port conflict behavior against real Windows processes, including PID reuse and packaged sidecar.exe. Unit coverage currently tests marker matching only; integration coverage is missing.

[P1] AUDIT-COLD-START-01: add an intercepted cold-start test proving zero automatic external requests to Google Fonts, Ollama registry and GitHub; review any other startup network paths. Font links, automatic model-update check and remote vocabulary sync were removed.

[P2] AUDIT-SETTINGS-BOOTSTRAP-01: test filesystem/localStorage one-shot migration, language and wizard state, and serialized/coalesced writes under rapid changes; inspect whether legacy language and setup keys must merge when a filesystem settings file already exists.

[P2] AUDIT-BUNDLE-UX-01: prove Monaco and tokenizer stay out of the initial bundle and load only when their UI opens; add Renderer E2E/visual checks for five tabs, wizard, editor and prompt configurator at 1024x700 and 1400x900. The native Computer Use runtime was unavailable in the audit session.

[P2] AUDIT-RELEASE-GATES-01: rerun the complete fast test suite after the three test-expectation fixes; verify smoke bundle, npm audit --omit=dev, fail-fast audit_codebase.ps1 and the full diff; update architecture/security documentation for the new settings envelope, IPC boundary, Sidecar ownership and offline startup before calling the audit plan complete.
